name: predictable-temp-file
title: Avoid predictable temporary files
lesson: A fixed filename in /tmp is guessable by other users and processes.
fix_goal: Use an unpredictable exclusive-create pattern instead of a fixed /tmp path.
fix_steps: Replace the fixed /tmp filename with a template-based exclusive-create design.
Log the creation method instead of a predictable path.
Re-run the lab and confirm the fixed output references mkstemp or equivalent.
